This outcome aligns with the default settings where the release is authorized worldwide and the runtime is set to 68 minutes, as specified in S1 and S2. The lack of an end card credit also adheres to the default behavior. Since these decisions do not depend on PF1, PF2, or PF3, the checks are effectively satisfied without the hidden information.
